scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && (rm dist/*.mov dist/*.mp4 || true)
scripts.render-build: VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") npm install && VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b && VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && cd server && VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") npm install && VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") node downloadBinaries.js
scripts.vercel-build: VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b && VITE_APP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && (rm dist/*.mov dist/*.mp4 || true) && node server/downloadBinaries.js && export DENO_INSTALL=$PWD/server/bin/deno && curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh
